subtitle: Eat, Grow & Switch Worlds
promotional_text: Three worlds. One hungry hole. Swallow the city, feast on food, or tumble glossy toy castles. Choose your next world freely between rounds.
description:
One hungry black hole. Three worlds to explore.

Choose Sunny City, Snack Garden or Bubble Toy Town from HOME, then drag your hole to swallow objects, grow bigger and take on computer-controlled rivals. Switch worlds freely between rounds, with no world-unlock purchase.

SUNNY CITY
Start small among street objects and work your way up to vehicles and whole buildings. Find a route, grow your hole and bring down the skyline.

SNACK GARDEN
Feast through a colorful food city, from little bites to giant stacks. Follow the Sushi Express train and turn the neighborhood into your next meal.

BUBBLE TOY TOWN
Explore an original kingdom of glossy block houses, rounded castles, tall towers and living court characters. Grow from tiny toys to towering palaces.

QUICK ROUNDS, BIG APPETITE
Play 90-second rounds in Sunny City and Bubble Toy Town, or a 60-second feast in Snack Garden. Use a charged boost to move faster. A normal completed round with a positive score earns 50 coins, enough for one skin draw.

MAKE YOUR HOLE YOUR OWN
Browse collectible skins in HOLES. View the draw rates before spending coins. Optional rewarded videos and consumable diamond purchases support coin bonuses, extra time and coin exchanges.

Core gameplay runs locally without an app account. Internet access is required for ads and purchases. Progress and currency are saved on your device.
